fixed_model_parameters.XGBoost: 150 trees; reg_lambda=10; hist; squared-error; n_jobs=2; subsample/colsample=1; no early stopping

validation.S1: 5 outer grouped folds by normalized formula; 3 inner grouped folds by normalized formula
validation.S2: PRIMARY OOD: 5 outer non-oxygen chemical-system-disjoint folds; 3 inner chemical-system-disjoint folds
validation.algorithm: GroupKFold shuffle=True; sorted formula IDs; group integers factorized in sorted order; outer random_state=314159; inner random_state=271828+fold
validation.sensitivity: After all B results, C1/C2/C3 repeat S2 for both targets and all five models. Restrict B S2 outer and inner assignments to retained formulas; retune only within those inner training folds. Reaggregate targets from retained CSV labels.
validation.selection: Same modest exhaustive grids as Phase3A; pooled inner-validation formula MAE; first candidate wins tie; no early stopping or outer-label selection.

secondary: R2 only N>=20 and target std>=0.1 eV
metrics.baseline: Training-fold median, same outer training/test rows as predictive model
metrics.uncertainty: 5000 paired chemical-system-cluster bootstrap draws, seed=424242. Resample G global chemical systems with replacement; all formula losses in a sampled system share its multiplicity. Preserve paired model/Dummy and S1/S2 losses. Pooled row-weighted MAE uses resampled total formula count. Percentile 95% bounds; no refitting during bootstrap.
metrics.improvement: Relative = 1 - model_MAE/Dummy_MAE; bootstrap ratio computed per draw. Also report paired absolute Dummy_MAE-model_MAE in eV.
metrics.validation_contrast: For B, paired S2-minus-S1 formula loss contrast with same chemical-system cluster resampling, all predictive models; no presumption of degradation.
